agenda_items.section: Report from Fire and Police on Mobile Home Fire
agenda_items.title: 4. Report from Fire and Police on Mobile Home Fire
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Police Chief Greg Festa and Interim Fire Chief Michael Calderazzo gave an update regarding a mobile home fire in Boulder Meadows.

agenda_items.title: 2. OPEN COMMENT and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE – 6:28 PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council heard comments from the public regarding a population survey, electric assist bicycles, and wastewater issues.

agenda_items.title: 3. CONSENT AGENDA – 6:47 PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved House Agenda Items 8A thru 3C, including a smoking ban and several ordinances.

agenda_items.title: 3. PUBLIC HEARING. - 7:05 PM Items 5A through 5C were conducted at the hearing.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted the 2015 budget and various resolutions for the CACD, UACID, BPA, and GID funds.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A LANDMARK ALTERATION CERTIFICATE TO BOURBON CONTRIBUTING ACCESSORY FILLING; CONSTRUCT A 6' X 6' HEARTBECK, FLAGS ON PATIO, AND BASKETBALL COURT; RETAINING WALLS AND FIRE PIT WITH CONCRETE BASE AT 437 HIGH LAND LAYERS EILE MALLON ON HILL HISTORIC DISTRICT PER SECTION 9-1-16 OF THE BOURBON REVISED CODE (BRS2014-01176).
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved with conditions an Alteration certificate for the construction of a rear deck, porch, and fence at 437 Highland Avenue.
